facts.business: Umiya Buildcon Limited (formerly MRO-TEK Realty Limited) is engaged in telecom and railway products, turnkey projects/system integration, services, and real estate development.

guidance_or_targets.statement: India's data centre IT load capacity expected to reach approximately 4.7 GW over the next three years
Addressable market for AI and data centre networking solutions estimated at around Rs. 6,500 crore

key_risks: High skill manpower bench is limited
facts.related_party_note: All Related Party Transactions were on arm's length basis and in ordinary course of business. Shareholders' approval obtained for material transactions with Umiya Builders and Developers and Umiya Buildtek. Prior omnibus approval from Audit Committee for repetitive transactions. Quarterly disclosures made to Audit Committee. Reports filed with Stock Exchanges under Regulation 23(9). Policy available on company website.
